Building Permit Statistical Reports

Building Permit Statistical Reports

The monthly Statistical Report provides a year-over-year comparison of building permits, units, and value listed by type of project. The report also lists to-date construction value and revenue, as well as other types of permits issued.

The monthly Issued Building Permits Report lists permits issued by the City, including project addresses, occupancy and work types, project value, and contractor and applicant information.
